studies.Title: Levels of serum trace elements in renal cell carcinoma cases.
studies.Reference: Levels of serum trace elements in renal cell carcinoma cases.
studies.Journal: Asian Pacific journal of cancer prevention : APJCP
studies.Population: Newly diagnosed renal cell carcinoma cases and healthy controls
studies.comparison_type: Serum zinc levels in renal cell carcinoma cases versus healthy controls

extraction_supporting_text.sample_size: In our study, trace element levels were measured with furnace atomic absorption spectrophotometry in 33 newly diagnosed renal cell carcinoma cases (preoperative) and 32 healthy controls. When compared with the control group, it was found that the levels of cadmium (Cd), lead (Pb) were higher and the levels of zinc (Zn), iron (Fe) and manganese (Mn) were lower in the patient group.
